title: Tofu and mushroom noodles
summary: Tofu and mushroom noodles is a chinese dinner built around smoked tofu and chestnut mushrooms, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice smoked tofu and chestnut mushrooms before the pan is hot. Tofu and mushroom noodles is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry smoked tofu until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add chestnut mushrooms and buckwheat noodles, return smoked tofu, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Tofu and mushroom noodles before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the noodles, simmered in salted water until tender.
